### Travel Cancellation Policy — Overview

The policy covers three categories:

**✈️ Flight Cancellation**
- **Free window:** Full refund within 24 hrs (domestic) or 48 hrs (international) of booking
- **Basic Economy:** Not cancellable after free window (unless insured)
- **Economy:** Fee of max($50, 15%) domestic / max($75, 20%) international
- **Business:** 5% domestic / 8% international
- **First Class:** Free cancellation
- **Travel Insurance:** Covers cancellation regardless of cabin class

**🏨 Hotel Cancellation**
- Free if 48+ hours before check-in (standard rooms)
- 50% of first night if 24–48 hours; full first night if <24 hours
- Suites are non-refundable

**🚗 Car Rental Cancellation**
- Free if 24+ hours before pickup; one day charge if <24 hours
- Luxury/SUV rentals have an additional $50 surcharge

The policy has been appended as an **"Appendix: Travel Cancellation Policy"** section at the end of the Q3 report for the Executive Team's review.
